findings.span: marking a pivotal moment in municipal water testing
findings.problem_name: Inflated claim of historical importance
findings.context_explanation: The phrase elevates an ordinary opening into a pivotal moment without evidence of broader historical significance.

suggested_operation.instruction: State the opening plainly while preserving 14 March 2019 and the Tuesday nitrate-testing schedule.

findings.span: stands as a pivotal beacon in the evolving landscape of circular living
findings.problem_name: Inflated significance and stock AI phrasing
findings.context_explanation: Stands as, pivotal, beacon, and evolving landscape turn a concrete organization into an unsupported legacy claim.

suggested_operation.instruction: Replace the significance framing with a sourced description of the repair café, preserving its name and 2018 opening date.

findings.span: “the useful mess—screws everywhere.”
findings.problem_name: Attributed quotation carries specific author voice
findings.context_explanation: The unusual detail is an attributed quotation; curly quotation marks and one em dash alone are not defects under the false-positive rules.

suggested_operation.instruction: Keep the founder's quotation exactly as supplied.

findings.span: We are committed to delivering exceptional solutions that create meaningful outcomes.
findings.problem_name: Portable sales filler precedes the measured result
findings.context_explanation: The commitment, exceptional solutions, and meaningful outcomes language could fit any organization and adds nothing to the concrete service result.

suggested_operation.instruction: Lead with the dated wait-time reduction and preserve the support team, 19-minute baseline, and 11-minute result.

findings.span: Let me be clear:
findings.problem_name: Fake-candid throat clearing
findings.context_explanation: The staged clarity announcement delays the board decision and adds no information.

suggested_operation.instruction: Begin with the board's deferral and preserve both dates, counsel's role, the causal link, and the negation.

findings.span: In a rapidly changing environment, teams must continuously adapt to new realities.
findings.problem_name: Generic opening delays the decision context
findings.context_explanation: The portable sentence does not identify the queue problem, measured delay, owner, option, or deadline.

suggested_operation.instruction: Open with the 11-day approval delay and the director's October 1 decision.

findings.span: unlocks seamless alignment and empowers every team to move faster with confidence
findings.problem_name: Promotional inflation makes unsupported outcome claims
findings.context_explanation: The alignment, speed, and confidence claims use sales language without evidence or a mechanism, while the CSV import is concrete.

suggested_operation.instruction: Remove or substantiate the broad outcomes and retain the sourced CSV-import capability.

findings.span: service name, start time, and customer impact
findings.problem_name: Three-item list is a complete factual enumeration
findings.context_explanation: The form names exactly the three fields the on-call lead reviews, so the grouping is functional rather than padded.

suggested_operation.instruction: Keep all three required fields and the explanation of why they are grouped.

findings.span: revolutionary workspace unlocks limitless productivity for ambitious teams
findings.problem_name: Promotional puffery replaces a concrete product claim
findings.context_explanation: Revolutionary, unlocks, limitless productivity, and ambitious teams are broad sales claims unsupported by the concrete plan limits.

suggested_operation.instruction: Remove or substantiate the promotional claim and preserve the one-project and 2 GB free-plan limits.

findings.span: Nope.
findings.problem_name: Single blunt fragment serves the personal voice
findings.context_explanation: One short fragment can supply emphasis, and here it supports the writer's candid change of mind rather than creating a row of dramatic fragments.

suggested_operation.instruction: Keep the blunt fragment and surrounding change-of-mind cadence.

findings.span: — though it contains one chair and a broken lamp —
findings.problem_name: Genuine aside preserves specific personal voice
findings.context_explanation: The parenthetical adds concrete, unusual detail and an intentional voice beat; the false-positive rules say em dashes alone are not a defect.

suggested_operation.instruction: Keep the aside, its punctuation, and the chair, lamp, and Nana details.

findings.span: approximately 10,000
findings.problem_name: Approximation matches the source precision
findings.context_explanation: The wording retains the uncertainty of the attributed source's around 10K instead of inventing a more exact number.

suggested_operation.instruction: Keep the approximation, attribution, quotation, and 2026-06 time scope.

findings.span: Reduced invoice reconciliation from 9 hours to 2
findings.problem_name: Resume form states a measured outcome directly
findings.context_explanation: The elliptical resume-bullet form is genre appropriate and immediately gives a concrete before-and-after measurement.

suggested_operation.instruction: Keep the resume-bullet structure and every number, team detail, mechanism, and month-end outcome.

findings.span: the west stairwell was closed after smoke was reported
findings.problem_name: Passives appropriately preserve unknown actors
findings.context_explanation: The report explicitly says it does not identify the closer or first observer, so an active rewrite would not make responsibility clearer without invention.

suggested_operation.instruction: Keep the passives, 03:12 UTC timestamp, location, event order, and explicit unknown-actor statement.

findings.span: The samples were randomized
findings.problem_name: Methods passive keeps the procedure in focus
findings.context_explanation: The procedure and blinding sequence are the point, and the sentence does not supply a randomizing actor that an active rewrite could name.

suggested_operation.instruction: Keep the passive and the full order of randomization, label concealment, and database lock.

findings.span: The specimen is accepted
findings.problem_name: Protocol passive keeps the specimen as the useful subject
findings.context_explanation: The acceptance rule concerns the specimen and its conditions; no responsible actor is supplied or needed for comprehension.

suggested_operation.instruction: Keep the specimen-centered clause and the quarantine consequence.

findings.span: the label, consent code, and collection time
findings.problem_name: Three-part list states the complete acceptance condition
findings.context_explanation: All three fields are required and jointly govern acceptance, so the list is factual rather than a forced rhetorical group.

suggested_operation.instruction: Keep the three field names, their all-match condition, and the one-field quarantine rule.

findings.span: requests are rejected
findings.problem_name: Security rule keeps the affected requests in focus
findings.context_explanation: The threshold and rejection condition matter here, while the text does not identify a component whose name would make the rule clearer.

suggested_operation.instruction: Keep the passive, 90-second threshold, and 4-second clock qualifier.

findings.span: “never the token”
findings.problem_name: Deliberate repetition carries an operator-facing safety warning
findings.context_explanation: The writer explains that the repeated wording helps new operators remember the exact logging boundary, so it has a clear function.

suggested_operation.instruction: Keep the repeated quotation, exact negation, key ID distinction, and second-language voice.

findings.span: not merely an upgrade; it is a transformative leap for every team
findings.problem_name: Formulaic contrast inflates the migration claim
findings.context_explanation: The not-merely contrast and transformative-leap phrasing add drama without naming a concrete change in v4.1.

suggested_operation.instruction: Remove the formulaic promotion while preserving the version, dry-run command, possible two-index result, modality, and cluster scope.

findings.span: exactly 23.7%
findings.problem_name: Unsupported precision contradicts the approximate source
findings.context_explanation: The source supports only an approximate share near 24%, so the exact decimal adds factual precision the source does not provide.

suggested_operation.instruction: Use the source's approximate precision and preserve the Q2 2026 time scope.
